Front: displays and the counter. Back: growers, the incubator and the research bench. Nights have no clock.

Honey wood, teal enamel and a warm aquarium canopy. This is your actual first display; its stock and price stay yours.
Cream porcelain, a coral cap and a pressure dial. Collect Bloom here in normal play; the details move with the station.
Coral clay, a custard chin, petal fins and a heart-shaped tail. This study uses the same model as your living stock.
An ochre cardigan, a teal beret and expressive eyes. The same model browses, queues and celebrates purchases in your store.
A linen apron and work cap share the customer rig. Idle, walk, greet and carry are motion studies; staffing comes later.
Look-only preview. Back in your shop you interact, grow and sell.
Brookkin family. Pouty lips and big eyes that follow you. Trick: blows you a bubble. Habit: a nose-down bob.
Brookkin family. A freckled tummy and a topknot. Trick: balloons up, spins and burps. Habit: hiccups.
Brookkin family. Banded, with long trailing ribbons. Trick: a barrel roll. Habit: a slow ribbon wave.
Sparkline family. A lantern on a curly stalk. Trick: a double flash with sparkles. Habit: its lantern breathes.
Airfin family. Pearl sails with violet rims. Trick: a little loop. Habit: hovers with its sails out.
Round, in an orange knit and a beret, with a tote. Reactions: haggles, pleased, shocked, ouch.
Tall and thin: green sweater, mustard scarf, flat cap, coin purse. Squints hard when haggling.
Pear-shaped: plum coat, bow tie, bowler, round spectacles, magnifier. Raises one brow when haggling.
A wide cream coat, a top hat and a gold gift bag. Looks half-lidded and unimpressed when haggling.
Shop teal with a cream apron and a visor, on a step stool behind the counter. Reactions: focused, pleased, oops, greeting.
Sturdy, in teal overalls, a beanie and work gloves; carries a crate between stock and displays.
A long teal lab coat, mossy hair, goggles and a vial in the pocket; focuses hard while dosing.
